title: Your Visa Card May Include Free International Data You Don't Know About
excerpt: Visa Signature and Infinite cardholders can claim complimentary GigSky eSIM plans covering 175+ destinations — a hidden perk for frequent travelers.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Visa Signature cardholders get 1GB of free data; Infinite cardholders receive 3GB annually.
  • The eSIM plan covers over 175 destinations without needing a physical SIM swap.
  • Eligible cards include Chase Sapphire Reserve, Capital One Venture X, and several Chase Freedom cards.
  • Claimed plans can be held for up to one year before activation, allowing for travel planning.

A Hidden Travel Perk

If you carry a Visa Signature or Visa Infinite credit card — and there is a good chance you do — you may already have access to free international mobile data. Through a partnership between Visa and GigSky, a global mobile data provider, qualifying cardholders can claim a complimentary eSIM data plan covering more than 175 destinations worldwide.

https://x.com/CoffeeGirlTX/status/2079926578637607174

The benefit flies under the radar. Unlike flashy sign-up bonuses or airport lounge access, it rarely gets marketing attention. But for diaspora travelers who regularly fly between the United States and India, or anywhere else internationally, it offers a practical way to stay connected without paying carrier roaming fees.

What You Get

The specifics depend on your card tier. Visa Signature cardholders receive 1GB of international data valid for 15 days, available once per calendar year, plus a 20% discount on additional GigSky plans. Visa Infinite cardholders receive 3GB for 15 days per year, with a 30% discount on additional purchases.

An eSIM is a digital SIM card embedded in your phone's software, meaning you can add a data plan without swapping out your physical SIM. Most smartphones sold in the last few years support dual-SIM functionality, so you can keep your regular number active for calls and texts while using the GigSky eSIM for data abroad.

![Visa Signature. Key Takeaways Visa Signature cardholders get 1GB of free data; Infinite cardholders receive 3GB annually.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/38/300_Toni_Stone_Crossing.jpg/3840px-300_Toni_Stone_Crossing.jpg)

Which Cards Qualify

The list of eligible cards is broader than many expect. Popular Visa Infinite cards include the Chase Sapphire Reserve, Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card, and U.S. Bank Altitude Reserve.

On the Visa Signature side, qualifying cards include the Chase Sapphire Preferred, Chase Freedom Unlimited, Chase Freedom Flex, several Ink Business cards, and the Wells Fargo Autograph and Active Cash cards.

The simplest way to check eligibility: look for the Visa Signature or Visa Infinite logo on your card, or verify directly through the GigSky app.

"I've used it, and GigSky does work fine most of the time, so the eSIM benefit is worth trying. And since you can get one for each eligible card, travelers with multiple Visa cards can end up with a ton of data."

— Katie Genter, The Points Guy

How to Claim It

Activation takes about five minutes. Download the GigSky app from the Apple App Store or Google Play, create an account, add your qualifying Visa card, and claim the complimentary plan. Install the eSIM on your device and activate it before or during your trip.

One useful detail: once claimed, the plan remains valid for up to one year before it activates automatically. That means you can redeem it now even if your next international trip is months away.

![Visa Infinite. Visa Infinite cardholders receive 3GB for 15 days per year, with a 30% discount on additional purchases.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/38/300_Toni_Stone_Crossing.jpg/3840px-300_Toni_Stone_Crossing.jpg)

Limitations and Alternatives

The free data allotment will not cover heavy usage. Streaming video or downloading large files will burn through 1GB or 3GB quickly. For travelers who need more bandwidth, GigSky offers paid plans with the Visa partnership discount applied.

Alternative eSIM providers like Airalo, Nomad, Holafly, and Saily are worth comparing if the complimentary plan falls short. But as a zero-cost baseline for navigation, messaging, and email on international trips, the Visa GigSky benefit is hard to beat.

For NRIs who travel back to India regularly, this is free money left on the table if you do not claim it.
